about: The spans of days the scorecard replays the detector over: around every case of the ground truth in low Earth orbit since 2020 whose sets the Archive holds, each from before the case's first stage to after its last. A span's sets are the catalogue's history class, a day at a time, kept as day slices in the Archive (docs/archive.md).

spans.cases: ADRAS-J with the H-2A stage; Kosmos 2576 with USA 314
Kosmos 2581 to 2583; Kosmos 2588 with USA 338; Kosmos 2558's subsatellite; Otter Pup 2
